Name: Shemaiah, Chief of the Levites
Summary: Shemaiah, a chief of the Levites and brother of Cononiah, gave with the other chiefs five thousand small cattle and five hundred oxen for Josiah's Passover.
KeyStory: Conaniah, Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings.
RelatedPeople: Cononiah, Chief of the Levites; Nethaneel, Chief of the Levites; King Josiah
LifeLesson: Brothers leading together supplied the Passover for all.
